# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 51 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** The Tablets Found by Solomon; Closing Colophon

---

**51:1** And in the days of Solomon the king of Israel, the tablets of Seth were found, and Solomon read them and gave thanks to God.

**51:2** And Solomon caused all the words to be copied and written in the books of the kings of Israel.

**51:3** And this is the end of the life of Adam and Eve, who were the first of all the living, and their hope is in the mercy of God.

**51:4** Glory be to God, who has mercy on all his creatures, now and forever.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
